scope: Development-only paired static 3D render diagnostics. Original and SAM textures use the same source canonical geometry; no age shape or production acceptance.

observations.training_overlap: Unknown; these development subjects are not independent validation.

capture.renderer: Actual FaceViewer, original GLB maps/filtering, sRGB output, ACESFilmic tone mapping, exposure 1.05, original four lights and fog(8,19)
capture.viewer_settings: studio lighting, solid mode, compare=false, grid=false, autoRotate=false; disable controls damping after resetting camera to remove frame-order dependence
capture.camera: Perspective 36deg, aspect1, near0.05 far100, target(0,-0.05,0); front(0,0.03,4.9), side(4.9,0.03,0), actual 90-degree side
capture.MASK: Original material: transparent=false, alphaTest=0.5, depthWrite=true, premultipliedAlpha=false, opacity=1
capture.BLEND: Same original map/material lighting: transparent=true, alphaTest=0, depthWrite=false, premultipliedAlpha=false, opacity=1; only these flags change. This matches research alpha flags, not the full CanvasTexture sampler/filter path (which disables mipmaps and uses LinearFilter).
capture.age_neutral_loading: Direct GLB load as static with unknown API source_age; no timeline sampler or invented target age. Preserve all eight SAM same-age controls.
capture.image: Actual viewer.exportPNG() canvas render; top-left PNG orientation, full clean viewport, no UI or raw atlas substitution
capture.geometry: Verify position/normal/index/UV typed-array SHA against source invariants for every loaded GLB before capture and after each material/view/background change; also record and compare normalization/world transforms, material type/side/roughness/metalness/color and map color space/UV/filter/wrap state within each source pair
capture.transport: Owned loopback-only Vite and exact allowlisted asset server; reject external browser requests; close all owned resources
capture.freeze: Hash protocol, viewer dependencies, harness, source reports and all GLB/atlas assets before and after; reject drift and refuse output overwrite

evaluation.identity: Fixed previously pinned CPU YuNet/SFace algorithm; all 376 frames re-detected independently. Retain NO_FACE/MULTIPLE_FACES and every requested denominator; no threshold.
evaluation.age: Fixed MiVOLO V2 CPU float32 predictor in separate 35-package environment; reuse render identity detection boxes/status, floor/ceil clipped zero-padding crop without landmark warp; normalized black body placeholder; raw age*122+61, no clamp/round/gender export
evaluation.paired: Each of 37 SAM assets at eight configurations paired with its original source static 3D frame at exactly the same configuration (296 pairs). Reuse 80 original frames; never treat repeated views as independent sources.

metrics.identity_cosine: Cosine of target render versus original static render; require both embeddings; descriptive, no identity acceptance cutoff
metrics.age_shift: target render age minus original static render age
metrics.condition_deviation: target render age minus requested SAM target condition; signed, condition is not ground truth
metrics.static_condition_deviation: original static render age minus requested SAM target condition
metrics.original_age_error: Original static frames only: prediction minus known research filename source age; keep unknown labels null

evaluation.pair_complete_cases: Age metrics share both-estimates complete cases; identity has its own both-embedding complete cases. Preserve individual frame results and separate age/identity failure denominators.
evaluation.summaries: Separately for each of eight material/view/background configurations and same_age_control/other_condition/unknown_source_age (24 paired summaries), average scored observations within source, then equally weight effective sources. Eight original-render summaries use only the eight known filename ages, retain ten requested frames and unknown count.

bootstrap.unit: Effective source IDs sorted lexicographically, random.Random(base_seed + int(SHA256(UTF8(key))[:16],16)); n rng.randrange(n) draws per replicate, shared across each metric vector with the same complete-case set
bootstrap.interval: Sorted linear interpolation at (N-1)*0.025 and 0.975; null for zero units; explicit degenerate one-unit interval. Conditional descriptive uncertainty, not missingness correction or independent validation.

evaluation.input_integrity: Bounded image snapshots and frozen metadata/source/model/environment pins before inference and after all aggregation; drift prevents successful publication
evaluation.interpretation: Texture coverage, missing UV regions, alpha/material/background, pose and rendering domain can affect detection/age/identity. This study measures those confounds on existing static geometry; raw-photo condition improvement is not a 3D baseline.
